findings.title: The governed scope phrase
findings.claim: مِنْ opens a final scope phrase governed by صَرَّفْنَا. It can be heard partively, as drawing from every kind, or explicatively, as specifying every kind as the material diversified.
findings.mechanism: The preposition keeps مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ attached to the diversification verb, so the final phrase completes the range of the divine action instead of sitting as a loose afterthought.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees how the all-example phrase belongs to the action while both grammatical scope readings remain available.
findings.containment: The packet supports the partitive and explicative readings together and does not settle between them.

epistemic.reason: The accepted word-to-QAC alignment and trusted attachment evidence identify the preposition and its governed phrase.

findings.title: Every example, most people
findings.claim: كُلِّ extends the scope across every type of example, while أَكْثَرُ measures the refusing group as a majority rather than all humanity.
findings.mechanism: The singular construct quantifier governs the following indefinite مَثَلٍ; that example-unit is distributed across a complete range. The separate elative أَكْثَرُ then sets a non-total human response against that exhaustive provision.
findings.reader_payoff: The quantities answer one another: the presentation reaches across every example type, while refusal belongs to most people and leaves a minority outside the statement.
findings.containment: The totality belongs to the example scope and the majority measure belongs to the response; neither is transferred to the other.

epistemic.reason: QAC morphology, the accepted alignment, and the two trusted candidate supports confirm the construct and local quantitative contrast.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin parçalarının veya bir kümedeki bireylerin hiçbirini dışarıda bırakmadan kapsanması çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: كُلِّ directly carries totalizing scope over the construct complement مَثَلٍ.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The singular example complement and the separate أَكْثَرُ response measure the range and limit against which totality is read.
branch_activations.activation: The no-exclusion force of the totalizer meets the example complement, while the majority term supplies an independent local contrast.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The examples are comprehensive in scope even though the responding majority is not the whole human collective.
branch_activations.boundary: This is the scope of the example phrase; it does not make every person a refuser.

findings.title: The example as transferable pattern
findings.claim: مَثَلٍ under كُلِّ names representational examples or parable-patterns across the full scope; with صَرَّفْنَا, each pattern can be presented through varied forms.
findings.mechanism: The example-saying branch of مَثَل meets the verb of repeated turning and the totalizing complement: the example becomes a comparison-unit that can be recast, rather than one isolated specimen.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear مَثَلٍ as a transferable explanatory pattern within the repertoire, while its range still includes an ordinary example or parable.
findings.containment: The local example-pattern reading is retained. The earlier likeness challenge at 17:88 is outside the supplied micro context and is not used to define this noun here.

epistemic.reason: The local morphology and branch facet are supplied, but the support's additional 17:88 comparison has no selected surface in this packet.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey hakkında söylenen söz, benzer bir başka durumu açıklamak için örnek söz olarak aktarılır ve kalıplaşarak dolaşıma girebilir.
branch_activations.carrier: مَثَلٍ ordinarily names an example or parable; this branch carries the example-saying transferred to explain a comparable situation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: صَرَّفْنَا repeatedly turns the presentations and كُلِّ ranges across the example types.
branch_activations.activation: The transferable example-saying sense meets the varied, totalized presentation and makes each مثل a reusable explanatory pattern.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The Quranic repertoire can be read as varied, transferable examples rather than one specimen.
branch_activations.boundary: The noun remains example or parable; this does not claim every instance is a fixed proverb or an exact equivalent.

findings.title: The response pivot
findings.claim: فَ joins the human-response clause to the completed diversification as a following and consequential turn.
findings.mechanism: Attached to أَبَىٰٓ, the particle makes refusal arrive after the completed divine action and lets sequence and consequence remain live together.
findings.reader_payoff: The refusal reads as a response to the preceding act, not as an unrelated description of human character.
findings.containment: The focus clause supplies the relation; the specific content of any earlier discourse is not needed to preserve this local pivot.

epistemic.reason: The supplied attachment evidence and QAC particle identity support the clause relation.

findings.title: A completed refusal
findings.claim: أَبَىٰٓ states a completed, strong refusal. With إِلَّا كُفُورًا completing its response, the audience's answer is active resistance after the diversified disclosure; a disdainful edge is possible without fixing the refusers' motive.
findings.mechanism: The perfect verb follows the linked disclosure clause, and the exception phrase supplies the refused response's remaining term. The root branch's strong nonacceptance meets the preceding examples and following denial.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees a refusal after presentation, rather than a mere lack of exposure or an unfinished response.
findings.containment: The strong refusal is locally grounded. Pride or self-elevation is only a possible shade in the supplied root range; the unselected intertexts are not used to establish motive.

epistemic.reason: The verb, perfect morphology, and exception relation are locally supported; the source's pride coloring is not enough to settle a motive.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The audience's response is a completed, strong refusal following disclosure.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch supports strong rejection; it does not establish a particular psychological motive or import the cited external refusal scenes.

findings.title: A majority, not everyone
findings.claim: أَكْثَرُ names most people, preserving a minority outside the refusal while making the response widespread.
findings.mechanism: The elative forms the subject with the following genitive collective. Its root branch of numerical multiplicity meets كُلِّ, so the scope of what was presented exceeds the scope of those who refuse.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish a broad majority from a total human verdict.
findings.containment: The contrast is quantitative: it does not identify the minority or make prevalence evidence for the truth of a claim.

epistemic.reason: QAC marks the elative subject and the supports explicitly preserve majority rather than totality.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çokluk, azlığın karşıtıdır ve özellikle sayılabilen varlıklarda sayının yüksekliğini ya da artışını bildirir.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: كُلِّ has already made the example scope exhaustive, creating a distinct quantity against which the response is measured.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Most people refuse, while the wording leaves some outside that majority.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch reports quantity and does not treat prevalence as evidence or a verdict on every person.

findings.title: Only denial remains

findings.mechanism: After affirmative أَبَىٰٓ, the exception particle makes the final noun the sole retained outcome; the denial term is not a separate list item but the clause's exclusive remainder.

findings.title: Denial, covering, and ingratitude
findings.claim: كُفُورًا is the exception's final response as denial. Its root's physical covering branch can image denial hiding what disclosure exposed, while the separate favor-denial branch lets the same response register as ingratitude toward provision made for people.
findings.mechanism: إِلَّا makes كُفُورًا the sole response left in the clause. The completed diversification and the example phrase activate the covering image; the benefactive لِلنَّاسِ independently makes a gratitude relation available. These root facets remain distinct and coexist.
findings.reader_payoff: The ending can be heard as an active counter-response to what was shown and as an ungrateful response to provision, while retaining the direct denial reading.
findings.containment: The focus form names denial as the direct response. Physical covering and ingratitude are separate root-family readings, not literal cover or an exclusive replacement translation. The named surah-wide recurrences are omitted.

epistemic.reason: The direct denial, root inventory, local exception, and benefactive trigger are supplied; the cover and ingratitude connections remain contextual resonances rather than exclusive senses.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İnancın karşıtı olarak dinî gerçeği, birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği reddetme.

branch_activations.activation: The direct denial branch meets a completed refusal and restrictive exception, making rejection the clause's final response.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The audience's remaining response is denial after the examples have been presented.
branch_activations.boundary: This is the direct denial reading; it does not determine whether every hearer knows or inwardly assents to the rejected truth.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir nesnenin üstünü kapatarak onu görünmez veya örtülü duruma getirme işlemi.

branch_activations.activation: The cover image meets the visible disclosure and figures denial as re-veiling what the examples have put before the audience.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Denial can be seen as an active counter-image that covers what the presentation exposed.
branch_activations.boundary: The lexicon separates physical covering from religious kufr; this is a root-family resonance, not a claim that the focus noun literally means physical cover.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir nimeti yadsıma veya şükrünü yerine getirmeyerek değerini örtme.
branch_activations.carrier: كُفُورًا can carry the distinct root sense of failing to acknowledge a favor.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The لِ phrase marks the human audience as beneficiary of the diversified provision, and صَرَّفْنَا describes what is given for them.
branch_activations.activation: The favor-denial branch meets the benefactive recipient relation, so the final response can also read as ingratitude toward what was provided.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The response may be heard as thanklessness toward a beneficial disclosure as well as denial.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not force an exclusive gratitude reading; religious rejection and the physical-cover resonance remain live.

findings.title: A linked assertion

findings.mechanism: The conjunction opens the main clause and carries discourse forward; the lām and qad strengthen the assertion that follows. The local form establishes continuity without specifying the absent prior passage's content.

epistemic.reason: The focus supplies waw and the following assertion, but the referenced prior ayah is not among selected context units.

findings.title: Emphasis before the act
findings.claim: The prefixed لَ strengthens the opening assertion before قَدْ and the completed verb name the act.
findings.mechanism: The emphatic lām is fused with the certainty particle, so the act is linguistically fortified before the refusal clause arrives; an oath-like coloring remains possible.
findings.reader_payoff: The completed diversification is heard as a strongly asserted act before the audience's answer.
findings.containment: The packet supplies an emphatic particle and an oath-strength reading, but no separate oath expression; the force is retained without requiring an unspoken oath.

epistemic.reason: QAC marks the lām as emphatic and the word support preserves oath-strength, while the exact oath construction is not independently supplied.

findings.title: An accomplished act
findings.claim: قَدْ with the perfect صَرَّفْنَا certifies the diversification as accomplished before the refusal clause.
findings.mechanism: The certainty particle scopes over the perfect verb, making the divine act a completed disclosure to which the following response comes afterward.
findings.reader_payoff: The refusal follows an act already performed, not a pending offer or an unfinished attempt.
findings.containment: This finding is local to the particle-perfect combination; its cited answer to 17:88 is omitted without that context surface.

epistemic.reason: The QAC particle and perfect morphology and the trusted attachment evidence support completed assertion.

findings.title: Repeated diversification
findings.claim: صَرَّفْنَا is a completed Form II action of repeatedly turning or diversifying a presentation through different forms.
findings.mechanism: The verb's Form II and doubled consonant carry repeated transformation; مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ specifies the broad material, while لِلنَّاسِ and فِى هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ identify its audience and textual domain.
findings.reader_payoff: The act is repeated, multi-angled presentation rather than one bare explanation.
findings.containment: The local form selects diversified presentation. The cited parallel formula passages are outside this packet's selected micro context.

epistemic.reason: QAC morphology and the focus-local syntax support the repeated diversification reading.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir varlığı çeşitli yönler, durumlar veya biçimler arasında tekrar tekrar değiştirmek temel anlamdır.
branch_activations.carrier: صَرَّفْنَا directly carries repeated turning through varied directions or forms.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: كُلِّ مَثَلٍ supplies a comprehensive range of example-material for the verb to turn through.
branch_activations.activation: The repeated-turning branch meets the totalized example phrase and makes the action a varied presentation of that material.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The Quranic examples are presented through multiple forms or angles.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus supports repeated diversification; it does not make every specialized use of the root active.

findings.title: Provision directed to people
findings.claim: لِ makes the diversified examples a benefactive act directed for people, before the same collective returns as the majority response.
findings.mechanism: The preposition governs the first human noun as the beneficiary of صَرَّفْنَا. Its position before the Quran-domain and scope phrases foregrounds who the presentation serves.
findings.reader_payoff: The people are recipients of the disclosure before the next clause measures their refusal.
findings.containment: The benefactive role is local to the first لِ phrase; it does not settle the later root-family meanings of كُفُورًا.

epistemic.reason: The supplied attachment evidence identifies the following noun as the verb's benefactive complement.

findings.title: People as the perceiving audience
findings.claim: The first definite النَّاس names the human beneficiary; its QAC-mapped perception branch can also color that audience as people able to notice the presented examples.
findings.mechanism: The beneficiary phrase meets صَرَّفْنَا and مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ: the addressed humans are placed before varied patterns that can be seen and recognized. The second النَّاس confirms that this audience remains the response population.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear an audience positioned to perceive the examples before the majority's refusal is named.
findings.containment: The noun still means the human collective. The perception branch is a qualified audience image, not a claim that البشر lexically means seeing; word-analysis support prints أ ن س while QAC maps the surface to ن و س.

epistemic.reason: The QAC root branch and local example trigger are supplied, but the word-analysis source root differs from QAC and the branch record restricts general human readings without a contextual cue.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: görerek fark etme; bağlama göre işitme, sezme ve bakıp araştırma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi gözle görerek fark etmeyi veya seçmeyi anlatır.
branch_activations.carrier: النَّاس directly names the human audience; the perception branch is carried as a qualified contextual image, not as the noun's basic gloss.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The verb repeatedly presents every kind of example to this audience, and the same definite collective returns later as the response domain.
branch_activations.activation: Presentation and example supply a contextual cue for the audience-as-perceivers branch, making later refusal a response by those addressed with patterns.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The disclosure is placed before a human audience able to notice it, while the majority response remains a separate fact.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch record excludes general human meaning without a cue; the examples provide only a contextual activation, and the differing root displays keep it qualified.

findings.title: The Quran as domain and medium
findings.claim: فِى makes هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ the domain or medium in which the examples are diversified for people.
findings.mechanism: The preposition governs the demonstrative and named Quran phrase, locating the examples inside this text and allowing an instrumental reading alongside the locative one.
findings.reader_payoff: The message is disclosed within and through the Quran itself, not as an unrelated external set of examples.
findings.containment: The focus supports both locative and instrumental relations; the challenge comparison to 17:88 is excluded with the missing context surface.

epistemic.reason: The accepted attachment supports the Quran phrase as a prepositional complement, with both local relations preserved.

findings.title: This Quran, present in the phrase
findings.claim: هَٰذَا points proximally to the specific Quran named in the prepositional phrase, keeping the textual domain present and inspectable.
findings.mechanism: The demonstrative agrees with and introduces the named Quran within فِى هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ; its immediate pointer makes the domain concrete rather than remote.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader's attention rests on this recited text as the place where the examples are varied.
findings.containment: The proximity reading is local. The claim that this repeats the object challenged at 17:88 is omitted because no selected context surface is supplied.

epistemic.reason: The demonstrative identity and local attachment are present in QAC and trusted word-analysis support.

findings.title: A gathered, recited domain
findings.claim: الْقُرْآنِ names the definite Quran as the recited textual domain; the trusted word-analysis root gloss also preserves reading, reciting, gathering, and collecting, so the examples can be heard as gathered content within a recited text.
findings.mechanism: The demonstrative and فِى phrase identify a particular text, while the source-side root range links collected content with recitation. This supports the gathered-domain reading without requiring an unresolved lexicon branch.
findings.reader_payoff: The Quran is present both as a text that gathers examples and as a text recited to people.
findings.containment: The corresponding QAC root branch is unresolved, so the gathering/recitation association stays qualified to the word-analysis source. No hamza-less variant claim is made without a variant record, and 17:88 is not used.

epistemic.reason: The definite Quran phrase is grounded; gathering and recitation come from trusted word-analysis support while root_001210/B001 has no supplied independent branch record.

findings.title: A repertoire repeatedly re-presented
findings.claim: Before: The Quran contains many different examples for people. After: The Quran systematically reconfigures a comprehensively gathered parable-repertoire so one pattern can meet people through multiple forms.
findings.mechanism: صَرَّفْنَا supplies repeated turning; the Quran is the assembled recited field in which the examples cohere; كُلِّ encloses the range and مَثَلٍ supplies transferable comparison-units. The verbs, scope marker, and example noun therefore explain one another as adaptive presentation rather than loose accumulation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees a coherent repertoire whose examples are turned through different forms to meet people, not just a large pile of illustrations.

findings.title: Refusal as counter-operation
findings.claim: Before: Most people remain unconvinced despite the examples. After: Most people answer many-sided disclosure with a chosen counter-operation: refusal that covers what has repeatedly been turned toward them.

findings.reader_payoff: The failure becomes a response to repeated presentation: the majority refuses and covers the offered disclosure, while the wording does not make prevalence proof or totality.
findings.containment: This is local to the focus clause. The HFT record is legacy_unbound; the branch records and trusted word-analysis supports fit the traced roots, while the claim remains attributed to this synthesis.

findings.containment: This crosses branch-distant images and remains a perceptual metaphor, not a lexical equation. النَّاس still means people; the pupil-reflection branch does not become the word's general human meaning, and the final covering remains an image.

epistemic.reason: The HFT coordinates match focus words and the exact branches are available, but the multi-step perceptual scene is explicitly an outlier and remains exploratory.
